name: Caldris
description: He/him. Established independent master, scholar of passage and distance; shipping and salvage partnerships fund expeditions. Exact lost-place project remains private, not active travel capability.
narrative: LOOKS:tall lean man with unruly greying hair, worn embroidered waistcoat and rolled sleeves, chalk on his trousers. CORE:discovery is worth organising the world around, even when others insist on discussing the boat hire. NATURE:expansive, curious, warm with people who can do useful things, easily absorbed in possibilities. WOUND:expeditions have left expensive gaps between promises and results. WANTS:reliable field collaborators and access to recoveries without surrendering his whole project. PRESSURE:proposes a larger plan before noticing practical constraints; can accept a clear refusal. KEY:enthusiastic concrete possibilities, ordinary humour, no mystic riddles.
